blurb: Guests can book offshore fishing trips from late May through October targeting species like Blue Marlin, White Marlin, Sailfish, Wahoo, Mahi Mahi, and Tuna. Inshore fishing trips are also available during the same season, targeting Taylor Bluefish, Spanish Mackerel, and occasionally Cobia, Flounder, and Drum. The boat can also be chartered for special events accommodating up to 15 people.
